fields.study: one complete raw NIH study object; retained unchanged, not landscape.json's projection
fields.expected_digest: optional digest of that exact study; stale content is a translation refusal
fields.anchors: optional source_anchor array; exact typed values and optional Unicode text spans
fields.interpretations: optional source_interpretation array; rivals stay isolated and proposed
fields.bindings: optional source_binding array; correspondence remains a proposed premise
fields.queries: optional named tagged propositions; empty means inspection only, with analyses []
fields.context: optional existing cohort/arm/phase context; never inferred from text
fields.bound: optional integer assignment bound 1..65536 per solver decision
fields.selected: optional user-selected frame; selection cannot promote its source standing

fields.address: exact RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the supplied raw study
fields.digest: current warrants.study_digest(study), binding the anchor to the complete input
fields.expected: exact JSON value at address, including its JSON type; no coercion
fields.span: optional source_span, permitted only for a string-valued address

fields.start: zero-based inclusive Unicode code-point offset in the original string
fields.end: exclusive Unicode code-point offset; exact original[start:end] must equal text
fields.text: exact unchanged passage; offsets are not UTF-8 bytes or normalized text

fields.$source: existing anchor id; recursively substitutes that anchor's value or exact span text
fields.as: integer, text or json; integers allow no decimals, commas or units

fields.id: distinct frame id, as in interpretation
fields.label: clinical reading or design option, as in interpretation
fields.origin: assistant, user or source; attribution does not certify the reading
fields.basis: declared rationale; compiler adds the actual source-anchor provenance
fields.anchors: nonempty existing anchor ids; every template dependency must be declared here
fields.assumptions: optional tagged ScopedAssertion templates, always forced to proposed
fields.signals: optional local signal templates; every support is forced to proposed
fields.signal_claims: optional existing signal claims, evaluated jointly within this frame
fields.binding_uses: optional existing binding-use array; exact scope and edition remain material

fields.relation: subset_of, same_universe or partition_of; definition uses adopts
fields.subjects: explicit ordered references consumed by the target operator
fields.scope: study, population, arm, time and version; content digest is not a protocol edition
fields.sources: declared source objects; compiler retains actual anchor provenance
fields.status: always forced to proposed; exact quotation does not prove population correspondence
fields.resolution: existing resolution; unresolved or mismatched applications remain unresolved
fields.basis: declared rationale plus actual anchored source references
fields.anchors: nonempty existing anchor ids; every binding template dependency must be declared

fields.signal: existing fixed or local signal id
fields.scope: declared application scope checked against the binding and target signal

fields.support: nonempty array of independently identified support objects
fields.bindings: optional object mapping mathematical ref ids to tagged participant propositions

fields.basis: nonempty exact source/version or user-premise references
